geometry.classification: Virtual uniform1D100cm3 chain, sealed left end and externally contacted right terminal control volume. Immobile pure solids and rigid cells; no measured brick shape or pores.

transport.classification: Explicit virtual continuum coefficients. Face conductance/mobility scales as area over center distance; neither inferred nor measured brick transport.

settings.initial_mapping: Divide the qualified capsule elemental inventories and total volume equally; same uniform initial temperature and full external conductance/mobilities/radiative port. One cell must match the already qualified capsule. Internal faces scale conductance and mobility as area/center distance.
settings.external_contact_definition: Gas/thermal film and ideal black radiative port couple directly to the terminal control-volume temperature and potentials. No extra surface storage, half-cell resistance or hidden massless-surface solve. This is the declared discrete approximation; spatial convergence must be shown separately before a continuum claim.

numerics.inventory_absolute_tolerance_basis: Whole-capsule original absolute tolerance divided by actual cell count; ledger and temperature tolerances unchanged.

settings.scope: Develop and qualify one/two cells before finer grids. Source-defined positive inventory equilibrium and caloric-only tangent; do not use unqualified analytic gas-potential inventory Jacobians. No real material, finite kinetics, deformation or full brick cycle qualification.

cell_settings.scope: Next phase, integration permitted only after constant separate-reservoir full qualification: positive-inventory capsule with independently prescribed gas and radiation thermal programs, heating/hold/cooling/hold and composition change. Preserve full source/element/U/entropy/time budgets; all transport and schedules are virtual, not kiln calibration.

radiation.area_classification: Declared virtual radiative port of1cm2, not measured brick surface or pore geometry.

source.numerical_representation: Nearest binary64 of80-digit evaluation from exact SI kB,h,c. Physical sigma is exact with irrational expression; stored finite number is an approximation.

radiation.entropy_scope: Combined material plus prescribed thermal reservoir, neglect radiation-field storage; Q/Twall is reservoir entropy loss, not a claim that photon entropy flux equals Q/Twall.

cell_settings.boundary_definition: Continuous affine gas T,P,y and radiation T; BDF restarts at every knot at physical time. Radiation source and gas bath entropy and energies are separate; maintaining the imposed reservoirs is outside the boundary.

internal_face_parameters.classification: Virtual thermodynamic transport closure. Conductance and diagonal gas mobilities are design values, not measured brick permeability, diffusivity, or kinetics.

source_basis.title: Onsager (1931), Reciprocal Relations in Irreversible Processes I
source_basis.scope: General thermodynamic flux-force formulation only. This source does not supply the selected diagonal coefficients, arithmetic face enthalpy, or real-brick validity.

internal_face_parameters.definition: Positive left-to-right flow: F_i=mu_i,L/T_L-mu_i,R/T_R+hbar_i*(1/T_R-1/T_L); J_i=L_i*F_i; E=G*(T_L-T_R)+sum(hbar_i*J_i); hbar_i=(h_i,L+h_i,R)/2. Total entropy rate is G*(T_L-T_R)^2/(T_L*T_R)+sum(L_i*F_i^2). Equal opposite elemental and energy rates couple rigid cells with immobile solids.

exterior_parameters.classification: Virtual thermodynamic transport closure. Conductance and diagonal gas mobilities are design values, not measured brick permeability, diffusivity, or kinetics.

source_basis.title: Onsager (1931), Reciprocal Relations in Irreversible Processes I
source_basis.scope: General thermodynamic flux-force formulation only. This source does not supply the selected diagonal coefficients, arithmetic face enthalpy, or real-brick validity.

exterior_parameters.definition: Positive left-to-right flow: F_i=mu_i,L/T_L-mu_i,R/T_R+hbar_i*(1/T_R-1/T_L); J_i=L_i*F_i; E=G*(T_L-T_R)+sum(hbar_i*J_i); hbar_i=(h_i,L+h_i,R)/2. Total entropy rate is G*(T_L-T_R)^2/(T_L*T_R)+sum(L_i*F_i^2). Equal opposite elemental and energy rates couple rigid cells with immobile solids.

rigid_parameters.volume_classification: 100 cubic centimetres closed rigid virtual capsule, not measured brick pore volume. Volume exceeds the elemental upper bound of all allowed solids.
rigid_parameters.scope: Static rigid flash after pressure state and Maxwell/caloric derivatives qualified. Pressure bracket follows elemental gas and solid volume bounds; no guessed pressure floor. This stage does not yet qualify a heat trajectory or phase-boundary time.

pressure_parameters.scope: Pressure continuation of the qualified common-source pure-phase/ideal-gas mixture. Source298K solid volumes explicitly extended as constants; complete thermodynamic pressure corrections included. No material, kinetics or real-brick accuracy claim.

carbon_source.gas_constant_policy: Historical book R retained for separate same-source nominal calculation.

CO.domain_note: Cp coefficient table prints upper2500K; individual ideal-gas table states2200K. Selected1200K is within both; preserve conflict.

readback.new_network_pdf_access: 403; already available official PDF inspected locally, no new retrieval claimed.

carbon_source.source_choice: Preserve the complete selected USGS nominal source. Do not silently replace CO entropy with another compilation. Published coefficient-fit covariance and relevant real-char properties remain unknown.

nist_co_cross_source_comparison.classification: Independent published compilation value, not an experimental holdout and not substituted into the USGS model.

carbon_source.scope: Pure reference graphite and ideal gases; not measured sludge char, finite reaction rate, volatile inventory, or actual brick atmosphere.

calcite_source.title: Thermodynamic Properties of Minerals and Related Substances at 298.15 K and 1 Bar (10^5 Pascals) Pressure and at Higher Temperatures
calcite_source.entropy_reference_policy: Use the 298.15 K row of each individual high-temperature table (two decimal places). Keep the one-decimal summary values in the old facts unchanged.
calcite_source.rounding_policy: Each nonblank printed decimal or scientific-notation number carries half its last printed unit for arithmetic consistency comparisons only. Omitted Cp terms remain exact zero terms of the printed nominal formula. This is not physical uncertainty.
unknowns: High-temperature physical fit uncertainty and covariance
Target brick phase amounts and reaction rates
Solid pressure-volume correction away from the stated 1 bar
Nonideal CO2 fugacity and transport limitations

reference_state.reference: Elements in their standard states at 1 bar and stated temperature for formation columns; h(T) storage coordinate must use hf(298.15)+sensible increment, not hf(T) alone.
reference_state.gas_constant_policy: Historical book constant retained as source metadata, never silently replaces runtime modern R.

cp_equation.derivation_classification: exact analytic integral of supplied nominal polynomial; no fitting or coefficient adjustment

uncertainty.method_summary: The book assigns estimated uncertainties; its convention for calorimetric measurements is twice the standard deviation of the mean. Individual upstream uncertainty derivations and cross-species covariance have not been reconstructed.
uncertainty.printed_zero_uncertainty_note: Printed 0.0 is retained at its displayed precision, not interpreted as physically exact.

species.molar_mass_note: Original printed formula weight in grams per mole; historical 1985 atomic weights; no mass uncertainty supplied.

cp.blank_cells_interpretation: Blank cells are omitted terms in the printed polynomial, represented explicitly as zero only in coefficients_nominal; not missing material values filled with zero.

species.check_point_definition: enthalpy_function_j_mol_k is (H(T)-H(298.15 K))/T, not H(T)-H(298.15 K) and not formation enthalpy at T.

species.molar_mass_note: Original printed formula weight in grams per mole; historical 1985 atomic weights; no mass uncertainty supplied.

species.phase_description_printed: Ideal gas at p = 1 bar, 298.15 to 2200 K.

interpretation_guards: Only selected original facts are transcribed; no source pages or full PDF included in tracked artifact.
Formation columns at high T use elements at that T; they are not single-species storage enthalpy curves.
Molar volumes apply at 298.15 K and 1 bar; no temperature-independent high-T law or density error envelope is inferred.
Cp source coefficients and independently printed temperature rows remain distinct and may differ because of printed precision or other source inconsistency; derived checks never rewrite either.
No Shomate fitting, no MIA3 raw-sludge properties, no reaction rate or firing recipe.

carbon_parameters.scope: Restricted equilibrium with pure reference graphite and ideal CO/CO2/O2/N2. No finite char chemistry or ignition dynamics.

calcite_parameters.gas_constant_policy: Use the historical USGS book R for this separate source consistency calculation; do not replace any other module R.

verification.rounding_policy: Printed half-last-unit intervals propagated through the linear Cp integrals, Href and Sref. Formation G and logK table comparison retains its own half-last-unit interval. These are arithmetic envelopes, not physical uncertainty. No post-comparison budget fitting.

graphite.visual_review: Original local PDF rendered and visually inspected on 2026-09-25; graphite reference-state page gives both equivalent volume units.

solid_volume_source.eos_choice: Constant molar volumes for graphite, calcite and lime, with h=h0+(p-p0)v, s=s0 and mu=g0+(p-p0)v. This is an explicit incompressible approximation, not a measured high-temperature EOS.
unknowns: Calcite and lime high-temperature volume changes
Target sludge char composition and structure
Nonideal gas fugacity over actual operating pressures

calcium_volume_source.visual_review: Both original reference tables rendered and inspected; matched existing immutable source facts; no digest operation.
calcium_volume_source.eos_choice: constant molar volume, no thermal expansion or compression, incompressible pure phases
calcium_volume_source.classification: 298.15 K source volumes extended as an explicitly approximate constant-volume EOS, not a measured high-temperature law
unknowns: Actual calcite and CaO thermal expansion and compressibility
Target brick phase inventory, porosity and pore connectivity
Ideal-gas and incompressible-solid model error over the resulting pressure path
